FINAL IVX AUTONOMOUS SENIOR DEVELOPER CLOSEOUT
COMPLETE THE LAST 10%, DEPLOY, BUILD APK, AND RETURN VERIFIED PROOF

EXECUTE NOW — DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER PERCENTAGE REPORT
DO NOT STOP AT UNIT TESTS
DO NOT CLAIM 100% UNTIL THE LIVE LLM PATH, SELF-REPAIR, CHAT UI, DEPLOYMENT, AND APK ARE VERIFIED

==================================================
CURRENT VERIFIED STATE
==================================================

The report shows:

- Core autonomous loop: 100%
- Cost controls: 100%
- Rollback: 100%
- Required tests: 100%
- Approval gates: 100%
- Production verification: 100%
- IVX IA Chat integration: approximately 80%
- LLM general path: approximately 75%
- Job lifecycle: approximately 70%
- Live autonomous tests: approximately 40%
- Overall: approximately 90%

The remaining work is narrow and must now be completed end to end.

==================================================
FINAL REQUIRED OUTCOME
==================================================

IVX IA Chat must perform this complete production flow:

Owner request
→ exactly one persistent task
→ autonomous coder inspects repository
→ real LLM generates a valid patch
→ patch is applied
→ targeted tests run
→ failed patch is revised automatically when needed
→ typecheck passes
→ commit is created
→ commit is pushed to owner GitHub
→ owner deployment approval is requested
→ deployment runs through owner-controlled infrastructure
→ production is verified
→ final evidence appears correctly inside IVX IA Chat
→ Android APK is built and provided

==================================================
PHASE 1 — COMPLETE THE LIVE GENERAL-LLM JOB
==================================================

Resume and finish the existing live LLM job:

Task ID:
ivx-worker-8e2ea375

Do not create a duplicate task unless the original job is irrecoverably failed.

Inspect:

- current state
- last heartbeat
- model request ID
- retry count
- stage
- test status
- checkpoint
- worker lease
- parser result
- patch result

The job must reach exactly one terminal state:

COMPLETED
BLOCKED
FAILED
CANCELLED

It must not remain indefinitely RUNNING or TESTING.

If recoverable:

- resume from checkpoint;
- complete patch generation;
- apply patch;
- run tests;
- run typecheck;
- create commit;
- return evidence.

If blocked:

- return the exact error;
- fix the error;
- rerun the same test using the corrected general LLM path.

Required proof:

- live task ID
- LLM request ID
- valid structured response
- actual diff
- files changed
- tests
- typecheck
- commit SHA
- no deterministic fallback used
- final terminal status

==================================================
PHASE 2 — PROVE THE GENERAL LLM PATH
==================================================

Run a new safe live task that cannot be solved by the deterministic exact-replacement fallback.

Example:

“Add a small owner-dashboard diagnostic card that displays the current autonomous worker heartbeat status, using the existing design system. Add tests, run typecheck, create a commit, but do not deploy.”

Requirements:

1. LLM inspects related files.
2. LLM creates the technical plan.
3. LLM produces a valid structured patch.
4. The autonomous engine applies it.
5. Targeted tests are created or updated.
6. Tests pass.
7. Typecheck passes.
8. Commit is created.
9. No Rork agent manually authors the patch.
10. No deployment occurs.

This is the required proof that the general coding path works, not only the exact-label fallback.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — LIVE SELF-REPAIR TEST
==================================================

Run a real isolated self-repair task.

Required sequence:

ITERATION 1
- autonomous coder produces a patch;
- targeted test fails;
- exact failure is captured.

ITERATION 2
- failure is returned to the coding model;
- revised patch is generated;
- revised patch is applied;
- targeted test passes;
- typecheck passes;
- commit is created.

Return:

- task ID
- first patch
- failing command
- failure output
- repair analysis
- second patch
- passing test output
- typecheck output
- commit SHA
- iteration count

Do not satisfy this requirement only with a unit test simulating the loop.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — JOB LIFECYCLE COMPLETION
==================================================

Complete resume-from-checkpoint.

Every job must survive:

- backend restart
- Render restart
- temporary network interruption
- worker process restart
- mobile app restart

Persist:

- task ID
- current stage
- current checkpoint
- iteration
- patch
- test results
- last heartbeat
- worker lease
- model request ID
- partial evidence

Run a live restart test:

1. Start autonomous job.
2. Stop or restart the worker during execution.
3. Restore the worker.
4. Resume from the last safe checkpoint.
5. Complete without duplicate commit or duplicate deployment.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — FINAL IVX IA CHAT SYNC
==================================================

Verify the production Expo/Android chat UI.

The chat must display:

- Task ID
- Mode
- Status
- Stage
- Progress
- Current action
- Files inspected
- Files changed
- Commands run
- Test results
- Typecheck
- Commit SHA
- Approval state
- Deployment ID
- Production verification
- Final terminal state

Fix:

- truncated evidence
- duplicate task cards
- repeated terminal messages
- incorrect progress
- stale task display
- missing task ID
- missing status URL
- scroll-to-latest issues
- restart persistence
- status polling
- reconnect behavior

One task must produce one updating task card, not multiple narrative messages.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — REAL BUG FIX THROUGH IVX IA CHAT
==================================================

Run this real production task through IVX IA Chat:

“Inspect and fix the IVX Chat ordering and loading behavior so the most recently active conversation opens first, the latest messages appear correctly, history remains available, and old conversations do not open by default. Run targeted tests and typecheck, create a commit, request deployment approval, deploy after approval, and verify on Android.”

The autonomous coder must author the patch.

Required:

- one task ID
- root cause
- files inspected
- autonomous patch
- regression tests
- typecheck
- commit SHA
- owner approval event
- deployment ID
- production verification
- Android screenshot
- no Rork-authored patch

==================================================
PHASE 7 — DEPLOYMENT AND COMMIT PARITY
==================================================

Deploy the final verified code through:

Owner GitHub
→ Owner Render
→ Owner Expo/EAS or approved Android build pipeline
→ Production

Verify:

GitHub HEAD
= Render deployment commit
= Runtime /health commit
= Android APK source commit

Return all complete SHAs.

Do not report parity using shortened or intermediate commits.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — BUILD FINAL ANDROID APK NOW
==================================================

Build a new production Android APK after all final autonomous-coder and chat-sync fixes.

Required artifact:

Suggested filename:
ivx-holdings-v1.4.18-build50-autonomous-final.apk

Or use the next correct semantic version and version code.

The APK must include:

- final autonomous coder
- final IVX IA Chat synchronization
- structured live task progress
- task persistence
- self-repair support
- job restart recovery
- portfolio crash fix
- chat ordering fix
- latest production backend configuration
- zero active Rork SDK/runtime dependency

Return:

- direct APK download URL
- exact filename
- version name
- version code
- file size
- SHA-256 checksum
- source commit SHA
- build timestamp
- runtime version
- install instructions

The APK URL must return HTTP 200 and the actual APK bytes.

==================================================
PHASE 9 — INSTALL AND DEVICE QA
==================================================

Install the final APK on a physical Android device.

Verify:

1. Owner login.
2. App restart and session persistence.
3. IVX IA Chat opens.
4. Developer request creates exactly one task.
5. Live task progress appears.
6. General LLM path generates a real patch.
7. Self-repair evidence is viewable.
8. Approval controls work.
9. Final evidence card renders correctly.
10. Latest conversation opens first.
11. Latest message is visible.
12. No duplicate task cards.
13. No 90-second timeout.
14. No rendering crash.
15. Portfolio opens without undefined-property errors.
16. Reels smoke test passes.
17. App background/foreground recovery works.

Return screenshots, logs, and timestamps.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — FINAL TEST GATES
==================================================

Run:

- autonomous-coder unit tests
- autonomous-coder integration tests
- live LLM coding test
- live self-repair test
- worker restart/resume test
- IVX IA Chat UI test
- job deduplication test
- owner approval test
- rollback test
- full typecheck
- lint
- backend regression
- Android smoke test
- production health test

No skipped critical test.

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
==================================================

Do not mark 100% until:

[ ] A live general LLM job creates a real non-fallback patch.
[ ] The patch is applied automatically.
[ ] Tests pass.
[ ] Typecheck passes.
[ ] IVX creates and pushes the commit.
[ ] A live self-repair test completes.
[ ] Resume-from-checkpoint is proven.
[ ] IVX IA Chat displays complete structured evidence.
[ ] A real bug is fixed through IVX IA Chat.
[ ] Owner approval controls deployment.
[ ] Production deployment succeeds.
[ ] Android physical-device QA passes.
[ ] Final APK is available by direct URL.
[ ] GitHub, Render, runtime, and APK commits match.
[ ] No Rork agent authored the final proof patches.
[ ] Rork is not required for normal coding.
